ns2:section.sectionText: The LEAD seminar introduces LEAD students to the basic principles of leadership and explores ways to exercise the characteristics of a successful student leader and future management professional. The course will foster a support network where students can share personal experiences of the realities of college life and encourage one another to utilize winning strategies to promote high achievement and success. In addition to learning from one another, students will have the opportunity to gain knowledge from visiting speakers who are leaders in their respective fields. In an effort to broaden the students awareness of the world and to develop global citizens, the Fall semester course will culminate with a rewarding study abroad experience.
